purpose: Convert the live Trader Apprentice lessons into falsifiable edge hypotheses. No candidate is considered proven until it survives out-of-sample testing with realistic execution costs and no lookahead.
core_rule: An edge is not a pattern description. It is a repeatable conditional expectancy after fees, slippage and basis adjustment.

candidate_edges.name: POST_CAPITULATION_FAILED_RECLAIM_SHORT
candidate_edges.hypothesis: After a large long-liquidation flush, a rebound with strong CVD and OI recovery but weak price repair below broken value is vulnerable to continuation lower if the first dVAL/dPOC reclaim fails.
preconditions: Large long-liquidation/deleveraging event in the preceding window.
Price remains below broken dVAL / prior-day-low / value boundary.
CVD rebounds materially from the flush low.
OI rebuilds materially from the flush low.
Price repair is small relative to CVD/OI repair.
candidate_edges.trigger: Failed reclaim/retest of dVAL or dPOC, preferably with a lower high and rollover.
confirmation: CVD recovery stalls or turns down.
OI stays elevated/rises as price weakens, or flushes only after the rejection confirms trapped leverage.
No rapid acceptance back above the rejected value level.
candidate_edges.invalidation: Acceptance above dVAL and especially dPOC with improving price response.
candidate_edges.why_it_may_work: It exploits crowding and buyer inefficiency after a leverage flush rather than chasing the initial liquidation candle.
candidate_edges.main_risk: False rejection before a true squeeze/recovery.

candidate_edges.name: POST_CAPITULATION_RECLAIM_LONG
candidate_edges.hypothesis: After a large long-liquidation flush, the first structural reclaim that is accompanied by stabilizing/rising CVD and non-pathological OI has positive short-horizon expectancy.
preconditions: CVD stops accelerating lower or turns up.
OI stabilizes or rises only with positive price response.
candidate_edges.trigger: Reclaim and acceptance above dVAL; stronger signal after dPOC reclaim/retest.
candidate_edges.invalidation: Loss of reclaimed value with CVD down and OI rising.
candidate_edges.why_it_may_work: It waits for proof that forced selling has exhausted and value is being rebuilt, avoiding blind knife-catching.
candidate_edges.main_risk: Late entry after a large reflex bounce.

candidate_edges.name: LEVERAGED_SELL_ABSORPTION_LONG
candidate_edges.hypothesis: When CVD falls and OI rises but price holds or rises at support/value, aggressive sellers are being absorbed and may fuel a squeeze if structure is reclaimed.
preconditions: Price flat/up or repeatedly unable to make new lows.
Price located at or just below an important support/value boundary.
candidate_edges.trigger: Reclaim/hold of the nearby structural level followed by positive price response.
candidate_edges.invalidation: Price breaks support and continues lower while CVD remains down and OI stays/rises.
candidate_edges.why_it_may_work: It measures failure of aggressive selling rather than seller activity itself.
candidate_edges.main_risk: Absorption can persist for a long time before finally failing.

candidate_edges.name: BEARISH_LEVERAGE_EXPANSION_CONTINUATION
candidate_edges.hypothesis: Price down + CVD down + OI up after old leverage has already been flushed has negative forward expectancy until the lost structure is reclaimed.
preconditions: Not merely the first vertical liquidation candle.
A support/value level is already lost or a retest from below fails.
candidate_edges.trigger: Failed retest of the lost level or continuation lower with OI still expanding.
candidate_edges.invalidation: Rapid structural reclaim with CVD stabilization/improvement and OI no longer expanding bearishly.
candidate_edges.why_it_may_work: New leverage is entering a falling market after prior leverage cleanup, making the downside move more directional than pure deleveraging.
candidate_edges.main_risk: OI does not reveal side directly; squeeze risk remains if price response reverses.

features_to_measure.failed_reclaim_count: Number of dVAL/dPOC reclaim attempts that fail acceptance within the lookback window.
features_to_measure.time_since_flush_minutes: Minutes since the largest recent liquidation impulse.
features_to_measure.oi_path_drawdown_pct: Peak-to-trough OI change around the event, not just distant endpoint delta.

minimum_backtest_protocol.dataset: Build timestamped snapshots from raw exchange/API data plus labeled value levels; screenshots are supplemental evidence, not the only source.
minimum_backtest_protocol.event_detection: Detect flushes and reclaim/failure events using only data available at that timestamp.
minimum_backtest_protocol.splits: Chronological train/validation/test; never random-shuffle across adjacent market regimes.
acceptance_gate: Adequate sample size across multiple volatility regimes.
No single day/week contributes a dominant share of PnL.
Stable result under modest parameter perturbations.

ranking_from_current_live_lessons.reason: The live sequence showed strong buyer/CVD/OI effort after the flush but weak structural repair. That inefficiency was visible before the continuation lower and is more specific than raw Price/CVD/OI direction alone.
ranking_from_current_live_lessons.note: Potentially robust but likely lower R multiple because it waits for confirmation.

model_instruction: Trader Apprentice must output EDGE_CANDIDATE, EDGE_EVIDENCE, EDGE_INVALIDATION and EDGE_STATUS. EDGE_STATUS must be HYPOTHESIS until the backtester marks it VERIFIED. Never report a historical anecdote as proven edge.
